finding: Completed Turn 29 investigation into Abaqus automatic static stabilization (*STATIC, STABILIZE). Empirically demonstrated two blockers: 1) Automatic energy fraction stabilization (*STATIC, STABILIZE=1.0e-4) aborts at Step 3 Increment 2 with '***ERROR: THE STATIC STABILIZATION DAMPING FACTOR COULD NOT BE CALCULATED' because all elements in the model are User Elements (UEL U1/U2) with zero continuum element volume/strain energy; 2) Constant factor stabilization (*STATIC, STABILIZE, FACTOR=1.0e-5) bypasses the calculation error but cuts back and diverges at the identical point (t=0.0366, dt < 1e-12) as unstabilized Package 80 because Abaqus viscous damping acts exclusively on mechanical DOFs 1-2 and does not regularize the coupled phase-field softening snapback at crack-tip Node 1239 (DOF 3). In accordance with the Standing Policy, submission of Package 81 is withheld, and direct loading continuation past Step 2 is recommended as the sound physical alternative.
